item.text:
Reconstructed all 32 verses in Urdu script, preserving the Persian opening and seven numbered stanzas. Moved the Roman transcription to `romanLyrics`, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Both editions have matching verse and stanza counts.

The opening phrase `Aah na shud baba rah` is ambiguous. I rendered it as `آہ نشد بابا رہ` to stay close to the recorded sounds.
